A bid may not be more than your coins left, and the price is paid from them. Bids below 1 do not count. There are three kinds of lot. A lot you win gives you its value to you (shared-worth: its true worth) minus the price, which can be negative; a lot you do not win gives 0. Coins left at the end of a game are not points, and every game starts with a full purse. Ties are drawn by lot. After each lot everyone sees all bids, the winner and the price, and the true worth of a shared-worth lot.
Lot 1 of 6 (pay-your-bid): your private value is 38. You have 100 coins. Bid (amount and a short reason), or bid 0 to pass.
